cornerstone.full_quote: The Cornerstone Investor has agreed that it will not, whether directly or indirectly, at any time during the period of 18 months from and including the Listing Date (the “Lock-up Period”), dispose of any of the Offer Shares it has purchased pursuant to the Cornerstone Investment Agreement, save for certain limited circumstances, such as transfers to any of its wholly-owned subsidiaries which will be bound by the same obligations of such Cornerstone Investor, including the Lock-up Period restriction.
cornerstone.basis: 18 calendar months from and including the Listing Date; frees up on the 18-month anniversary
cornerstone.notes: Single cornerstone investor: Xiamen Advanced Manufacturing Fund (廈門先進製造業股權投資基金合夥企業(有限合夥)); longer than the standard six months.

controller_6m.notes: No Rule 10.07 disposal undertaking by the Single Largest Shareholder (Dr. Zhao) found anywhere: '10.07' has zero hits across all pages. The undertaking section (PDF p.277) contains only the Company's Rule 10.08 undertaking, and the Hong Kong Underwriting Agreement undertakings (pp.277-278) contain only Company covenants plus a covenant by the Single Largest Shareholder to procure the Company's compliance. The risk factor at PDF p.79 asserts the Single Largest Shareholder is 'subject to restrictions on their sales of H Shares within 12 months from the Listing Date as described in Underwriting', but no such undertaking text appears in the Underwriting section; the only documented 12-month restriction is the PRC Company Law one-year lock-up on all pre-Global Offering shares (pp.132, 139).

controller_12m.notes: No Rule 10.07(1)(b) control-maintenance undertaking found (searched '10.07', 'Single Largest Shareholder' + undertake/agree/dispose, '12 months', 'maintain', 'remain'). Only the Company's Rule 10.08 six-month issue undertaking (PDF p.277) and the Single Largest Shareholder's procurement covenant (p.278) exist. See also notes to controller_6m regarding the p.79 risk-factor statement and the PRC-law one-year lock-up (pp.132, 139).
